column2: [From.GetTitledName] sent armed men to drag me to a cell. They found my gates barred and my retainers waiting. If my liege wants me in chains, [From.GetSheHe] will have to come and take me. From this day I answer to no one.
To arms!
My men came back empty-handed and bloodied. [From.GetTitledName] would not be taken and has raised [From.GetHerHis] banners against me.
Then I will take [From.GetHerHim] by force.
The guards of [From.GetTitledName] came at dawn. Now I sit on damp straw behind an iron door and listen to the rats.
I will remember this.
[From.GetTitledName] has been seized without a fight and now waits on my pleasure in the cells.
Word reached me that [From.GetTitledName] meant to throw me in a cell. I did not wait to find out how damp it was. I took what I could carry and slipped over the border by night.
By the time my men reached [From.GetTitledName]'s hall it was empty. [From.GetSheHeCap] has fled the realm.
Good riddance.
The door of my cell creaked open and the gaoler waved me out. [From.GetTitledName] has set me free.
Free at last!
The crowd has gathered and the headsman is testing the edge of his axe. [From.GetTitledName] has decided that I will die today.
May the gods judge [From.GetHerHim] as [From.GetSheHe] has judged me.
[From.GetTitledName] has banished me. I have been escorted to the border with what I could carry and told never to come back.
The world is wide.
[From.GetTitledName] demanded that I hand over my lands. I would sooner see them burn. My banners are raised and my gates are shut.
[From.GetTitledName] meant to hand me to another liege like a sack of grain. I refuse. I raise my banners and answer to no one.
[From.GetTitledName] meant to swallow my clan whole. My kin have taken up their weapons, and we will see who swallows whom.
[From.GetTitledName] meant to split my clan in two. My kin will not be divided, and we have taken up our weapons to prove it.
A blade flashed in the dark of my chambers, but I woke and cried out, and the shadow fled through the window. Someone wants me dead, and I do not know who.
I will sleep with a knife under my pillow.
The killer I hired has failed. [From.GetTitledName] still lives, but at least no one knows who sent the blade.
Next time.
At least [From.GetSheHe] bled.
[From.GetSheHeCap] will carry the mark for life.
A shadow came at me in the corridor. I fought it off, but not before its blade opened my side. Someone wants me dead, and I do not know who.
I will find who sent you.
The killer came at me in the dark and I fought for my life. I live, but I will never be whole again. Someone wants me dead, and I do not know who.
Curse whoever sent [Root.GetHerHim]!
My guards caught the killer before the deed was done. Under the hot irons the wretch talked: [From.GetTitledName] paid for my death.
[From.GetTitledName] will pay for this.
The killer I hired was caught by [From.GetTitledName]'s guards and gave up my name before dying. Everyone knows what I tried to do.
Curse the fool.
Curse the fool.
Curse the fool.
The killer got a blade into me before my guards cut [Root.GetHerHim] down, and before dying the wretch named [From.GetTitledName] as the one who paid.
[From.GetTitledName] will pay for this.
The killer maimed me before my guards cut the wretch down, but not before [From.GetTitledName] was named as the one who paid.
[From.GetTitledName] will pay for this.
A shadow moves in the corner of my chamber. A cold hand over my mouth, a sharp pain, and the dark.
It is done. [From.GetTitledName] is dead, and no one knows who paid for the blade.
Excellent.
A shadow moves in the corner of my chamber. It is a killer sent by [From.GetTitledName]. I know it as the blade goes in.
[From.GetTitledName] is dead, but my killer was seen and my name is on every tongue. The lords of the realm whisper about me, and the priests call me a murderer.
Let them whisper.
[FromFrom.GetTitledName] paid a killer to murder [From.GetTitledName]. Everyone knows it now. Something must be done.
I will ask our liege for justice.
Seize [FromFrom.GetHerHim]!
A blade for a blade.
I will let it go, for now.
[FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] is already in my dungeon. Bring the headsman.
It was our own liege who sent the killer. Let everyone know!
You ask your liege to punish the plotter.
[From.GetTitledName] stands before me and says a vassal of mine paid a killer to murder [From.GetHerHim]. [From.GetSheHeCap] demands justice.
Take the plotter's title, if you can.
Arrest the plotter.
This is not my affair.
[From.GetTitledName] has given my victim a claim on my title. Now [From.GetSheHe] is coming for it.
Let [From.GetHerHim] come.
[From.GetTitledName] has granted me a claim on the plotter's title. Justice will be done by the sword.
Justice!
[From.GetTitledName] has sent guards to arrest the plotter. Whether they catch [From.GetHerHim] or not, my liege has kept faith with me.
Good.
[From.GetTitledName] will do nothing about the plot against my life. So much for a liege's protection.
I will remember this.
Your liege will be exposed.
[From.GetTitledName] is telling everyone who will listen that I paid the killer who came for [From.GetHerHim]. The lords of my realm look at me differently now.
Lies! All lies!
Your priests have made their case, and I have listened. From this day my household keeps the rites of [Root.Religion.GetName]. May the gods forgive me the old altars.
You ask me to tear down my shrines and kneel at yours? No. The gods my fathers served will see me to my grave, and they will judge you too.
The title is yours to take back. I return it without a fight, though I will not pretend I am glad of it.
You want my lands back? Come and take them. I have held them with my sword and I will keep them with it.
Enough blood has soaked the fields. I accept your terms. Let the crows find another feast.
Peace? Not while I still have soldiers to march and you still have towns to burn. The war goes on.
Your gift arrived safely and is most welcome. I will remember this generosity.
I accept your offer. My banners will fly beneath yours, and my sword is yours to call upon.
I thank you for the offer, but I bow to no one. My realm stays my own.
I have weighed the match you proposed and I must refuse it. The betrothal will not go ahead.
I have considered the marriage you proposed and I cannot agree to it. Look elsewhere for a match.
I have considered your proposal of marriage and I must decline. There will be no wedding.
The ransom is paid and the prisoner walks free. A fair bargain, and a profitable one.
Your offer is an insult. The prisoner stays in my dungeon until you find a better price.
I will take the child under my roof and teach them what I know. They will return to you better for it.
I have no time to raise another's child. Find someone else to see to their education.
Very well. I set my ambition aside, as you asked. Do not make me regret it.
My ambitions are my own business. I will not abandon them because you ask it.
As you wish. I will no longer lend my support to that cause.
I stand by my word and my cause. My support will not be withdrawn.
I will stand with you in this. Count on my help.
Your ambitions are not mine. I will not join you in this.
I accept the lands you grant me and swear to hold them well in your name.
I am honoured to serve on your council. You will not find me wanting.
I must refuse the office you offer. Find another to fill that seat.
You will have your war. My armies will march upon your enemy as you asked.
I will not send my armies on your errand. Fight this war yourself.
The temple has heard your plea. Your marriage is dissolved, and you are free of that bond.
The temple will not undo what was sworn before the gods. Your marriage stands.
The Grand Theogonist has heard your complaint. From every pulpit in the Old World the name of your enemy is cursed and cast out from the temples. Let the faithful shun them.
Your plea has been heard by the high priests of our faith. Your enemy is cast out from among the faithful.
The temple will not cast out one of the faithful at your word. Your plea is denied.
I have heard your call to arms. My warriors are gathering and we march to join you.
I will not join your war. You must find your allies elsewhere.
Steel will decide it now. The war is begun, and the gods will judge which of us was in the right.
So it comes to blades between liege and vassal. The war is begun, and the whole realm will remember it.
I release the vassal back to you. Their oath is yours once more.
That vassal swore to me and to me they will stay. I will not hand them over.
I accept your invitation and will come to your court gladly.
I thank you for the invitation, but I will not leave the place I am in.
I accept you as my vassal. Serve me loyally and you will be well rewarded.
I have no need of your oath. Remain as you are.
The temple has weighed your penance. Your excommunication is lifted, and you may return to the faithful.
Your penance is not enough. You remain outside the temple doors.
The ransom is agreed. The prisoner will be set free.
There will be no ransom. The prisoner stays where they are.
I welcome you to my lands. Take the holding I offer and serve me well.
My lands are not for you and your sellswords. Look for a home elsewhere.
I will join your war. My warriors will fight beside yours.
I will not join your war. This fight is yours alone.
Done. My merchants will no longer trade with them.
My merchants trade where they please. I will not close my ports for you.
Done. My merchants will no longer trade with them.
My merchants trade where they please. I will not close my ports for you.
I have considered the betrothal you proposed and I must refuse it.
My clan will join yours. From today we ride under one banner.
My clan will never be swallowed by yours. Come and try, if you dare.
Our blood is mingled and our oath is sworn. Your enemies are my enemies.
I will swear no blood oath with you.
Let the feud end here. Our clans have buried enough of their dead.
No. The blood between our clans has not yet been paid for.
My kin and I will leave and found a clan of our own. Go in peace, as we do.
We will not split from the clan. Our place is here.
Your gold speaks well for you. You have my favour.
My favour is not for sale. Keep your gold.
You have my support. I will speak for you when it matters.
I will not lend you my support in this.
Agreed. Neither of us will raise a blade against the other while this pact holds.
I will not bind my hands with a pact. My sword stays free.
I accept your request and grant you a seat on my council.
I have no seat on my council for you.
I have heard your plea. The fighting inside my realm will stop.
My vassals will settle their quarrels as they see fit. I will not step in.
Very well. I will join the faction, as you demand.
I will not join that faction, whatever you threaten.
I will stand with you in your ambition.
I will not join you in this ambition.
I accept your gift with thanks. It will be treasured.
Let the dead rest
Then the feud goes on
Money well spent
Pity
Good
So be it
Peace on that border, then
So be it
A change to the laws of the realm has been put before the great and the good, and your liege awaits your answer. Your voice carries weight. Will you lend it to this change?
A change has been proposed to the laws of lands bound to your own by old oaths. As their overlord your word is wanted before the change is made.
A change has been proposed to the laws of lands that lie within the old borders of your realm, though their lord does not answer to you. Will you give it your blessing?
I approve.
I will keep my counsel.
I refuse.

The peasants of [Root.GetName] have risen against their masters. Pitchforks, flails and stolen spears will not stand long against a trained army, but a hungry mob can burn a great deal before it is put down.
Call out the levies!
Word comes that the peasants of [From.GetName] have risen in revolt. Keep the gates barred and the guards awake until the mob is broken.
We will be ready.
[From.GetName] has gone over to the rebels. The tax collectors were driven off with stones, and the last one was found hanging from the mill wheel.
Curse them all.
The rebels of [From.GetName] have scattered into the hills and forests. The fields can be worked again, and the gallows will be busy for a while.
Order is restored.
A Holy War is Called

[Root.GetTitledName] has called the faithful of [Root.Religion.GetName] to a holy war against [New.GetTitledName]. Warrior priests preach in every market square, flagellants whip themselves bloody on the roads, and the banners of the faithful gather to march on [From.GetName].

[Root.GetTitledName] has proclaimed that the gods hunger. The warbands of [Root.Religion.GetName] gather beneath their tattered banners to fall upon [From.GetName] and drown the lands of [New.GetTitledName] in blood.
[Root.GetTitledName] has called the faithful of [Root.Religion.GetName] to a holy war. Their armies gather to march on [From.GetName] and tear it from the hands of [New.GetTitledName].
For the faith!
This is no concern of ours.
To arms! They march on us!
Grim tidings for the faithful.
The Holy War is Won
The holy war for [Root.GetName] is over. [From.GetTitledName] has torn it from [New.GetTitledName], and the faithful sing of victory over the bodies of the fallen.
Glory to the gods!
Fanatics.
The Holy War Fails

The holy war for [Root.GetName] has failed. [New.GetTitledName] holds the land still, and the armies of the faithful straggle home in shame. The priests blame weak hearts, and the weak hearts blame [From.GetTitledName].
The gods are testing us.
So much for the high priests.
Ha! Let them lick their wounds.
The Holy War Comes to Nothing
The holy war for [Root.GetName] is over before a victor could be named. [New.GetTitledName] has taken up the faith of [From.GetTitledName], and there is no one left to fight.
The holy war for [Root.GetName] has come to nothing. [New.GetTitledName] no longer holds the land, and the faithful are left with sharpened swords and no enemy.
A Faith Reborn
The old ways live again!
We follow the reformed faith.
We keep to the faith of our fathers.
Strange days.
[From.GetTitledName] has taken me as a consort. I am no longer chained in the dungeon, but a cage of silk is still a cage.
I will remember this.
[FromFrom.GetTitledName] has taken my kin [From.GetFirstName] as a consort, against [From.GetHerHis] will. The shame of it falls on our whole house.
[FromFrom.GetFirstName] will pay for this.
My wife [From.GetFirstName] has been taken by [FromFrom.GetTitledName] as a consort. While I live this insult will not be forgotten.
My husband [From.GetFirstName] has been taken by [FromFrom.GetTitledName] as a consort. While I live this insult will not be forgotten.
There will be a reckoning.
I am honoured by the offer, but I cannot accept the lands you would grant me. Find another to hold them in your name.

The wedding feast is over and the last drunk guests have been carried home. By old custom my vassals owe me a marriage aid, a gift of coin to see the new couple well provided for. I could collect it, or let my generosity be the talk of the realm instead.
Collect the marriage aid.
Let them keep their coin.
The match is agreed. The banns will be read, the families will feast, and the two houses will be bound by blood.
Excellent!
Regrettably, the match cannot stand. Whatever the priests have said, the two kinds will not wed, and the families have taken back their word.
Regrettably, the match cannot stand. No child will ever come of a Fimir and this kind, and the Meargh would have you seek a mate among your own.
Damn you...
